  window.onscroll=function(){
    window.scrollTo(x,y)
  }
}

  }
}

  var isYT = false;
  if(document.body.contains(document.getElementById("song"))) {
    document.getElementById("song").play();
    isYT = false;
  } else {
    isYT = true;
    player.playVideo();
  }
}
